findings.claim: Two new Consequences overstate the code. 0005 says the action fails only when kmctl check fails, but action/knowledge-ci.sh also exits 1 when kmctl review due crashes (its own header says so), and audit mode exits 1 when claude errors or gives no findings. 0006 says every concept an agent writes is due until a person verifies it, but review_due skips handoffs (review_due.py:161), so handoffs are never due as unverified.

The 12-word cut leaves punctuation before the ellipsis ('handoff: ... so you,...') and gives the three review skills the same cut-off line ('The review instructions for .okf/X/ pages, used by the audit skill and...'), which never says to use them through /audit. Strip trailing punctuation before adding '...'.

src/kmctl/briefing.py has an unstaged ruff format change. The stamp ran on the working tree, which is formatted; the staged copy fails ruff format --check (checked on a copy). Stage it so what lands is what was stamped.

verdict.text: The change does what the plan says.
The briefing lists all seven skill folders, read from the plugin payload when it runs.
The two fields are gone from all nine records.
The seven records gain appended Corrections with Consequences, and nothing above them changed except the front matter the plan removes.
The log names all nine records.
All gates and rows pass.
Three findings remain, none blocking: two Consequences lines overstate the code, the cut-off summaries read poorly, and one format fix is unstaged.
`loopctl gate stamp` in the worktree: lint, format, tests and rows r1 to r5 all pass, "stamp green: a035668cbe3399b12cab4f83157116331542c12c411a1193b880764e8c55fdc2".
Diffed every record against HEAD.
The only body changes are the two removed front matter lines and the appended Correction; 0007 and 0009 only lose the two lines.
Checked each new Consequences line against the code.
0001: plugin.py stage/status/_claude and the hook's install hint.
0002: src/kmctl/rules/ and load_skills.
0003: the scaccogatto marketplace is added first, and marketplace.json has no version range.
0004: hooks.json, plus test_plugin.py tests for a missing and a failing kmctl.
0005: action.yml, knowledge-audit.sh (event guard, the four tools, the one issue) and the auditor's tools list (Read, Grep, Glob).
0006: review_due's shallow-clone and non-git notes.
0008: HANDOFF_DAYS = 14, newest-first sort, expired handoffs in review due.
All hold except the two in f1.
Briefing on this repo: 526 words, against a budget of 600.
Each entry is capped at its name plus 12 words, so seven skills add about 100 words.
Rows: r1 walks nested key paths over all of .okf/ against ALLOWED_FIELDS.
r2 accepts a Consequences heading at any level and checks the log for every record.
r3 has a real-payload test and a copy with an added skill, monkeypatched through plugin._payload, which skills_dir reads when it runs.
r4 is the existing budget test plus the strict validator.
r5 is a docstring grep plus test_supersede.
None of them is vacuous.
I4 honesty: _skill_summary's docstring says SKILL.md is Claude Code's format, not an OKF concept.
That is accurate, since I4 governs OKF fields, and the okf_fields tests still pass.
